url.title: Document URL
url.description: Link to a signed PDF, a signed XML file, or (with a signature file below) any signed document (max 25 MB). Leave empty when you use 'Document (base64)', 'EU act' or 'Documents'.

pdf_base64.title: Document (base64)
pdf_base64.description: The document as base64, instead of a URL (PDF, signed XML, or any file that has a separate signature file).

signature_url.title: Separate signature file URL (XAdES .xml)
signature_url.description: For a detached XML signature (XAdES / XML-DSig, e.g. a .xml or .sig next to a contract, or an EU Official Journal seal): link to the signature file. The document above is then compared with what the signature covers.

signature_base64.title: Separate signature file (base64)
signature_base64.description: The detached XML signature as base64, instead of 'Separate signature file URL'.

eu_act.title: EU act (CELEX or ELI)
eu_act.description: Check an EU Official Journal act published from October 2023: CELEX number (e.g. 32024R1689) or ELI (e.g. http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1689/oj). The Actor fetches the act's official seal (and the PDF, unless you give your own copy as the document) from the EU Publications Office.

language.title: Language of the EU act
language.description: Language version of the EU act (only used with 'EU act').

require_qualified.title: Require a qualified signature or seal
require_qualified.description: If true, a valid but non-qualified (advanced) signature gets REVIEW instead of ALLOW.

documents.title: Documents (batch)
documents.description: Up to 20 per run: [{"url": "..."}, {"pdf_base64": "...", "name": "contract.pdf"}, {"url": "contract.pdf link", "signature_url": "contract.xml link"}, {"eu_act": "32024R1689", "language": "DE"}]. Clear the single fields above when you use this.
